params.body:
The "Dependency audits" job fails every pull request: `composer audit --locked` and `npm audit --audit-level=high` both flag versions in the lock files. Only the lock files change; every version stays within the ranges `composer.json` and `package.json` already allow. Replaces #261, which covered Composer only.

| Package | From | To | Advisory |
|---|---|---|---|
| symfony/http-foundation | 8.1.4 | 8.1.9 | CVE-2026-108082, ReDoS in `HeaderUtils::split()` through the `Cache-Control` request header. Reachable by anyone who can send a request. |
| symfony/yaml | 8.1.2 | 8.1.9 | CVE-2026-109413, unbounded recursion in the inline lexer. Only `laravel/roster`, a dev tool, pulls it in. |
| follow-redirects | 1.16.0 | 1.16.1 | GHSA-q3jh-wrc6-jgq8, GHSA-8r9p-f939-6h3c: credential headers kept across cross-origin redirects. Node only, via axios; not in the browser bundle. |
| vite | 8.2.x | 8.3.5 | launch-editor GHSA-698v-4r3x-3vcv, GHSA-r825-w8mm-5pxw, GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm. Dev server only. |

`symfony/polyfill-mbstring` and `symfony/polyfill-php80` move to 1.43.0 as dependencies; Vite brings its own dependency updates.

## Checked

- `composer audit --locked` and `npm audit --audit-level=high`: nothing found.
- The frontend job's steps: `npm ci`, `npm run lint -- --max-warnings=12` (12 warnings, 0 errors), `npm run build`, manifest present.
- Full PHP suite on MariaDB 10.11 with the Composer change: 1380 tests, the same 21 failures as on `main` locally (Chrome printing, Vite manifest, build stamp, report PDFs), none new.

Unblocks the audit on #260.
params.title: Composer and npm locks past four security advisories
